sentences.en: Welcome to the Fiddy Working Heritage Farm
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到菲迪工作遗产农场。

sentences.en: This open-air museum gives you the experience of agriculture and rural life in the English countryside at the end of the nineteenth century
sentences.zh: 这座露天博物馆让您体验十九世纪末英格兰乡村的农业和农村生活。

sentences.en: So you'll see a typical farm of that period, and like me, all the staff are dressed in clothes of that time
sentences.zh: 因此，您将看到那个时期典型的农场，而且像我一样，所有工作人员都穿着那个时代的服装。

sentences.en: I must give you some advice and safety tips before we go any further
sentences.zh: 在我们继续参观之前，我必须给您一些建议和安全提示。

sentences.en: As it's a working farm, a please don't frighten or inure the animals
sentences.zh: 由于这是一个正在运作的农场，请不要惊吓或伤害动物。

sentences.en: We have a lot here, and many of them are breeds that are now quite rare
sentences.zh: 我们这里有很多动物，其中许多品种如今已相当稀有。

sentences.en: And do stay at a safe distance from the tools: some of them have sharp points which can be pretty dangerous, so please don't touch them
sentences.zh: 请务必与工具保持安全距离：其中一些工具带有尖锐的尖端，可能相当危险，因此请勿触碰。

sentences.en: We don't want any accidents, do we?
sentences.zh: 我们不希望发生任何意外，对吧？

sentences.en: The ground is very uneven, and you might slip if you're wearing sandals so I'm glad to see
sentences.zh: 地面非常不平整，如果您穿的是凉鞋，可能会滑倒——我很高兴看到……

sentences.en: you're all wearing shoes - we always advise people to do that
sentences.zh: 你们都穿着鞋子——我们始终建议大家这么做。

sentences.en: Now, children of all ages are very welcome here, and usually even very young children love the ducks and lambs, sO do bring them along next time you come
sentences.zh: 现在，所有年龄段的儿童都非常欢迎来这里，通常连很小的孩子都喜欢鸭子和小羊，所以欢迎您下次来时带上他们。

sentences.en: I don't think any of you have brought dogs with you, but in case you have, I'm afraid they'll
sentences.zh: 我想你们中应该没人带狗来，但万一有人带了，恐怕它们……

sentences.en: have to stay in the car park, unless they're guide dogs
sentences.zh: 必须待在停车场，除非是导盲犬。

sentences.en: I'm sure you'll understand that they a could cause a lot of problems on a farm
sentences.zh: 我相信您能理解，狗在农场上可能会引发很多问题。

sentences.en: Now let me give you some idea of the layout of the farm
sentences.zh: 现在，让我为您简要介绍一下农场的布局。

sentences.en: The building where you bought your tickets is the New Barn, immediately to your right, and we're now at the beginning of the main path to the farmland - and of course the car park is on your left
sentences.zh: 您买门票的那栋建筑是新谷仓，就在您的右侧；我们现在正位于通往农田的主路起点——当然，停车场在您的左侧。

sentences.en: The scarecrow you can see in the car park in the corner, beside the main path, is a traditional figure for keeping the birds away from crops, but our scarecrow is a permanent sculpture
sentences.zh: 您在停车场角落、主路旁看到的那个稻草人，是传统上用来驱赶鸟类、保护庄稼的造型，但我们的稻草人是一件永久性雕塑。

sentences.en: It's taller than a human being, SO you can see it from quite a distance
sentences.zh: 它比一个成年人还要高，因此您可以在很远的地方就看到它。

sentences.en: If you look ahead of you, you'll see a maze
sentences.zh: 如果您向前看，会看到一座迷宫。

sentences.en: It's opposite the New Barn, beside the side path that branches off to the right just over there
sentences.zh: 它位于新谷仓对面，紧邻从那里向右分岔的小径旁。

sentences.en: The maze iS made out of hedges which are too tall for young children to see over them, but it's quite small, sO you can't get lost in it!
sentences.zh: 这座迷宫由树篱构成，树篱太高，年幼的孩子无法从上面看到外面，但它规模很小，所以您不会在里面迷路！

sentences.en: Now, can you see the bridge crossing the fish pool further up the main path?
sentences.zh: 现在，您能看到主路更前方横跨鱼池的那座桥吗？

sentences.en: If you want to go to the café, go towards the bridge and turn right just before it
sentences.zh: 如果您想去咖啡馆，请朝桥的方向走，并在到达桥前向右转。

sentences.en: Walk along the side path and the café's on the first bend you come to
sentences.zh: 沿着这条小径前行，咖啡馆就在您遇到的第一个弯道处。

sentences.en: The building was originally the schoolhouse, and t's well over a hundred years old
sentences.zh: 这栋建筑最初是校舍，已有超过一百年的历史。

sentences.en: As you may know, we run skills workshops here, where you can learn traditional crafts like woodwork and basket-making
sentences.zh: 如您所知，我们在这里开设技能工作坊，您可以学习木工、编篮等传统手工艺。

sentences.en: You can see examples of the work, and talk to someone about the courses, in the Black Barn
sentences.zh: 您可以在黑谷仓看到这些手工艺作品的范例，并与相关人员了解课程详情。

sentences.en: If you take the side path to the right, here, just by the New Barn, you'll come to the Black Barn just where the path first bends
sentences.zh: 如果您从新谷仓旁向右走这条小径，就会在小径首次转弯处到达黑谷仓。

sentences.en: Now I mustn't forget to tell you about picnicking, as I can see some of you have brought your lunch with you
sentences.zh: 现在，我可不能忘记提醒您关于野餐的事，因为我看到你们中有些人已自带午餐了。

sentences.en: You can picnic in the field, though do clear up behind you, of course
sentences.zh: 您可以在田野里野餐，当然，请务必清理好自己留下的垃圾。

sentences.en: Or if you'd prefer a covered picnic area, there's one near the farmyard: just after you cross the bridge, there's a covered picnic spot on the right
sentences.zh: 或者，如果您更喜欢有遮盖的野餐区，农场院附近就有一处：您过桥后，右侧便有一个带顶棚的野餐点。

sentences.en: And the last thing to mention is Fiddy House itself
sentences.zh: 最后要提的是菲迪宅邸本身。

sentences.en: From here you can cross the bridge then walk along the footpath through the field to the left of the farmyard
sentences.zh: 从这里您可以先过桥，然后沿田间小径向农场院左侧走去。

sentences.en: That goes to the house, and it'll give you a lovely view of it
sentences.zh: 这条小径通向宅邸，并能让您欣赏到它优美的景致。

sentences.en: It's certainly worth a few photographs, but as it's a private a home, I'm afraid you can't go inside
sentences.zh: 它绝对值得拍几张照片，但由于这是私人住宅，很抱歉您不能入内参观。

sentences.en: Right
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, if you're all ready, we'll set off on our tour of the farm
sentences.zh: 那么，如果大家都准备好了，我们就出发开始农场参观之旅吧。
